summary.zh: 设计带审批与灰度发布的多阶段部署流程
summary.en: Design deploy stages with gates and canary rollout

description.zh: 梳理部署阶段划分、审批关卡、安全检查与灰度发布策略，用于规划零停机上线和多环境推进。适合统一发布流程，或排查流水线中失败的部署关卡。
description.en: Plans deployment stages, approval gates, security checks and canary rollout for zero-downtime releases across environments. Suits standardizing release flow or debugging failing deploy gates.
